subject.title: fix: resolve response prefix template variables in abort replies

question: Should maintainers repair this conflicting PR in place, replace it with a fresh current-main fix, or intentionally accept config-default-only abort prefixes?
rationale: The direct-path proof is useful, but the current branch is dirty and still has correctness risk around routed delivery plus active model/session state.

options.title: Repair before merge
options.body: Update the branch so routed abort delivery receives prefix context and abort prefixes seed from active session/channel/runtime model state, then rebase and rerun focused proof.

options.title: Replace with a fresh fix
options.body: Keep the linked issue canonical and use a new current-main implementation if preserving this stale branch is not worth the conflict and review churn.

options.title: Accept default-only mitigation
options.body: Merge the narrower behavior while explicitly accepting that routed or override sessions may still show raw or stale model/thinking prefix state.

recommendation.title: Repair before merge
recommendation.body: Update the branch so routed abort delivery receives prefix context and abort prefixes seed from active session/channel/runtime model state, then rebase and rerun focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history signal is ownership of the shared reply-prefix helper that the final fix should probably extend.
